notes.title: Movavi Video Editor 2024: It Gets Even Better
notes.content:
Meet the new Video Editor 2024!

Here are just some of the fresh features:

- Revamped timeline. 
The new timeline is now clearer and more streamlined. Get your projects done faster and have more fun with any types of videos.

- Frame-precise cuts in a click. 
Give your videos a sharper look with the new video-cutting tool. Easily make precise cuts and create eye-catching montages.

- Perfect-match overlay effects. 
Now each overlay effect has 13 blending modes to choose from. Try each of them  and pick the one that fits your video perfectly.

- Pro-quality color correction. 
Get next-level color correction with the same simplicity. Boost colors in a snap and make more viewers fall in love with your videos.

- Our best effects – at your fingertips. 
Create awesome videos in any style with our huge collection of professionally designed effects.
